name: Anastasia Brunell
source:
Anastasia is a student of Valudeto High and is well-known for being a bully. To top it off, she seems to be dating one of Valudeto High's delinquents, Enrico Moretti. 

Just like your typical bully, Anastasia harasses students as a means to get what she wants. She would go through extreme measures just to achieve her goal. In Lucia's case, locking her up in the bathroom all day long just because she didn't follow her commands.

That's when karma bites back and she becomes one of the first victims of a mysterious chain of deaths.
